$comment: SAMPLE PAYLOAD - SIMULATED DATA, NOT FROM A REAL VEHICLE.
description: The ESP32 is serving the app, but no CAN frames are arriving from the STM32.
whatTheAppDoes: The app stays connected and says so: 'The app is connected to the ESP32, but the ESP32 is not receiving data from the STM32.' Every STM32-sourced measurement becomes unavailable rather than frozen at its last value.

activeFaults.title: No data from the vehicle controller
activeFaults.description: The ESP32 is no longer receiving CAN messages from the STM32. Readings on screen are from before the link was lost and must not be treated as current.
possibleCauses: CAN wiring between the STM32 and the ESP32 is broken or disconnected
A CAN bus termination resistor is missing or has failed
The STM32 has reset, halted or lost power
recommendedActions: Stop the vehicle safely — the displayed readings are no longer live
Check that the STM32 has power and its status LED is behaving normally
Measure resistance across CAN-H and CAN-L with power off — roughly 60 Ω means both terminators are present
